question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The students demonstrated their __excitement__ by volunteering for community service.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"excitement"** means a feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness. (उत्साह)
 
 
• **Example: **The excitement before the big game was palpable among the fans.
 
 
 
• **"Enthusiasm" **refers to intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (उत्साह)
 
 
• **Example: **His enthusiasm for the project was contagious, spreading to the entire team.
